checks.lead: Hendrik Frensch Verwoerd (Afrikaans: [fərˈvuːrt];  8 September 1901 – 6 September 1966), also known as H. F. Verwoerd, was a Dutch-born South African politician, academic, and newspaper editor who served as Prime Minister of South Africa from 1958 until his assassination in 1966.
